svg.title: Akshay Bajpai. In thrust we trust. I lead technology from the first client conversation to the release: the architecture, the team, the code, and the runbook after. Boardroom to bare metal. The name is inked, outlines first. A rocket engine is drawn by a plotter, dimensioned and cut at section A-A, then lit; it vectors on its gimbal while an x-ray lens drifts over it and shows the software inside. A strip lists the sheets in the set.

g.text: I lead technology from the first client
conversation to the release: the architecture,
the team, the code, and the runbook after.
Built to hold under load and fail loud.
